Class VirtualModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.client.VirtualModel
public class VirtualModel extends Object
Client-side model that mirrors the authoritative game state held by the server. Updated incrementally by the Client in response to server notifications, and read by the UI to render the current board state. All mutating methods are synchronized to support concurrent access from the network thread and the UI thread.

    • onDrawUpdate

      public void onDrawUpdate(CardDTO c, String nickname)
      Removes the drawn card from the appropriate draw list and adds it to the drawing player's hand. Building cards are added to the player's building list; all other cards are added to the character list.

      Note: the if-else branching on card type could be replaced with a Strategy pattern.

      Parameters:
      c - the card that was drawn
      nickname - the nickname of the player who drew the card

    • onReturnToQueue

      public void onReturnToQueue(TileDTO tileDTO, PlayerStatsDTO playerStatsDTO)
      Updates the queue, board, and player stats to reflect that a player's pawn has been returned to the queue tile. Marks the target queue tile as occupied, frees the player's board tile, and updates the player's stats.
      Parameters:
      tileDTO - the queue tile the player has returned to
      playerStatsDTO - the updated stats of the player who returned to the queue
